staff: choose approved lines in one call
reading: one model answers one request at a time, so three characters answer in turn; compare all_three_s with the budget before deciding how much the ReactionQueue must hide
limit: staff replies carry no case facts; twelve fixed trainee turns; measured with whatever else was running

written_staff_replies_parallel_requests_.note: qwen3.5 does not support parallel requests in this Ollama ("model architecture does not currently support parallel requests"), so setting OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=3 gave no overlap

note: The patient reply is written by the model from the earned facts (server/dialogue Dialogue.reply); the nurse and the anaesthetist both choose an approved line of their own closed intent list in ONE short model call (Dialogue.pick_many) and speak the pre-rendered line, so nothing a model writes is spoken for staff. 12 fixed trainee turns on the 6 GB desktop, one model, one request at a time. The staff speak fixed lines, which is the price of the budget: with written staff replies the same measurement is 5.9 s (target 4 s, not met).
